description: This file contains a test class 'FvpDevicesTest' that performs hardware device checks and CPU hotplug tests on a system, using SSH commands and device file interactions.

classes.name: FvpDevicesTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying device presence, CPU hotplug functionality, and specific hardware components like RTC, watchdog, networking, and RNG on a target system.

methods.name: run_cmd
methods.description: Executes a command on the target with optional retries, handling SSH connection issues.

methods.name: check_devices
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a minimum number of devices of a given class and verifies driver usage.

methods.name: check_rng
methods.description: Verifies RNG device output by grepping specific device files.

methods.name: set_cpu
methods.description: Enables or disables a CPU core by writing to sysfs.

methods.name: test_cpu_hotplug
methods.description: Tests CPU hotplug functionality, including enabling/disabling cores and ensuring at least one core remains active.

methods.name: test_rtc
methods.description: Checks for RTC device presence and runs hwclock.

methods.name: test_networking
methods.description: Checks for networking device presence and tests outbound connectivity.

methods.name: test_virtiorng
methods.description: Verifies virtio RNG device presence and functionality.
